from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """One document's title and its assigned legal cause category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title as it appears in the text (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_category: Literal[
        "所有权纠纷",
        "行政主体 - 劳动和社会保障行政管理（劳动，社会保障）",
        "执行案由 - 行政非诉执行",
        "贪污受贿罪",
        "执行案由 - 其他案由",
        "行政行为 - 行政给付"
    ] = Field(description="The single legal cause category assigned to this document from the provided 6 options")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Collection of extracted document classification records."""
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
